title: myroxylon hawaiense
intro: Myroxylon hawaiense, commonly known as Hawaiian sandalwood, is a plant species native to Hawaii. It is valued for its essential oil, which has been used in traditional medicine for centuries due to its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Hawaiian sandalwood oil include promoting relaxation, reducing anxiety, and alleviating pain. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties include α-santalol, β-santalol, and other sesquiterpenoids.
